title: Enchanted Encounter

outfit_card.silhouette: A grand fairytale ballroom silhouette featuring an opulent bell-shaped ballgown skirt, fitted corset waist, scalloped wing-like peplum drapery, and ethereal flared multi-layered sheer sleeve cuffs.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A pointed fairytale hennin cap in pale pink, adorned with gold celestial filigree, lace-trimmed brim, and dangling crystal star earrings with delicate chains.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A stiffened corset bodice with celestial sunburst gold embroidery, framed by a delicate pleated lace collar, iridescent crystal choker, and billowy ruffled off-the-shoulder sheer organza sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous layered crinoline ballgown skirt of shimmering pleated satin, overlaid with scalloped iridescent organza petal tiers and embellished with radiant golden starlight and starburst hem embroidery.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Multi-layered iridescent crystalline fairy wings extending from the back, paired with an ornate star-topped crystal wand trailing shimmering magical starlight.
